note: The four station roles, in full. One source for the role cards (build_kit.js) and for section 3 of every sector binder (binder_manual.js). Edit here, never in a DOCX.

roles.title: SECTOR CHIEF
roles.tagline: You are accountable for this sector and you speak for it at Council.
do: Make the final call inside the station when the team cannot agree.
Decide what the sector pays for, trades away, and keeps.
Go to the central Council table the moment COUNCIL IN SESSION shows on the console, with the Liaison.
Speak for the sector at Council. One seat, one voice: yours.
dont: Leave the station for any reason except Council.
Sign Transfer Chits. That is the Liaison's signature.
when: If you are not at Council, your sector has no voice for that sitting.
If the team is three people, you also keep the Station Operations Log.

roles.title: LIAISON
roles.tagline: You are the only member of this station permitted to leave it.
do: Carry every question to other stations: a specification value, a trade, a worker.
Negotiate every trade, fill in and sign every Transfer Chit, and carry it to Transport.
Bring the three-digit value your procedure needs back to the Systems Lead, written down.
Go to Council with the Chief when it is called. You may speak there; you hold no seat.
dont: Send anyone else out. Nobody else leaves the station.
Hand over stock without a chit the receiving Liaison has signed.
when: While you are away no chit can be signed, so no transfer can be completed.
Before you go, tell the team what you are asking for and what you can offer.

roles.title: SYSTEMS LEAD
roles.tagline: You hold the binder and you work the console.
do: Look up every fault code in section 12 and read the procedure in section 13 aloud, all of it.
Enter the resolution code and the Workers assigned count, then press SUBMIT REPAIR.
Send and answer requests in RESOURCE EXCHANGE, and run the sector's own panel.
Keep the console's INVENTORY and the chits on the table matching.
dont: Guess a code. Three wrong codes in a row lock the console for 20 seconds.
when: RESOLUTION REJECTED: re-verify the source table or the sector that gave the value before trying again.
MATERIALS NOT READY or INSUFFICIENT CREW: stop, stage what the procedure lists, then submit.

roles.title: ENGINEER
roles.tagline: You keep the station running and the record straight.
do: Count the chits and workforce tokens, and move them whenever the console moves stock.
Keep the Station Operations Log in section 15: time, event, decision, who agreed.
Stage the workers and materials a procedure lists before the Systems Lead submits.
Watch NEXT UPKEEP and say out loud when the sector cannot afford it.
dont: Leave the station. A worker can be lent to another sector only through a Transfer Chit, and a token moves with it.
Let the table and the console disagree for more than a minute.
when: A worker is injured: turn the token face down and tell the Systems Lead to press REQUEST MED HEALING.
A new round starts: run the NEW ROUND box in section 5 before anything else.
